negative_findings.description: No dedicated, standing publication channel was found for cash-in-transit / cash handling procurement by MK municipalities and utilities. Searches using 'пренос на пари', 'транспорт на готовина', 'обезбедување' returned only unrelated municipal material-transport tenders, УЈП procurement procedure documents, and the AML law.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cash-in-transit demand appears to be visible only as individual notices inside ЕСЈН, not via any topical aggregator or supplier-side register I could locate.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CIT is a core Printec-adjacent service line; if it is only discoverable via keyword filtering inside ЕСЈН, the collection design must rely on a well-tuned MK keyword/CPV filter rather than on any dedicated feed.

negative_findings.description: No public tender notice or procurement page was found for the ЈСП Скопје 'Скопска' electronic ticketing / mobile payment system, despite abundant media coverage of the scheme itself. ЈСП does not appear to maintain a public procurement listing of its own that search engines surface.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only media and operator pages (radiomof, skopjeinfo, fakulteti, a1.mk) describe the scheme; the underlying contracts were not locatable from the open web in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Fare collection is one of the highest-volume municipal payment estates in MK; if its contracts are only reachable via ЕСЈН authority-level search or FOI, that must be an explicit collection step rather than an assumption.

negative_findings.description: WebFetch of the ЕСЈН open-data contracts page returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot-defence, not as a dead source; the page is referenced from multiple government pages and is presumed live but unverified by me.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The open-data layer is the highest-value structured source in this cell; the collection design must budget for a browser-context or authenticated fetch path rather than a plain HTTP client.

negative_findings.description: The State Commission for Appeals in Public Procurement appears under at least three hosts in search results: dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and dkzjn.sorsix.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: I did not determine which is canonical or whether the others are legacy/mirror/vendor instances.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pointing a scheduled collector at a legacy host risks silently stale appeals data on a high-value source.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific commercial tender-aggregation service was confirmed for this cell. One result (gtbc.net 'North Macedonia tender notices 2026 by sector') suggests such aggregators exist, but I did not verify its coverage, sourcing or terms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Commercial aggregator landscape unmapped; not recorded as a candidate because I could not substantiate it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A licensed aggregator could remove the need to scrape ЕСЈН, but only if its coverage of municipal/ЈП buyers is genuine rather than a reseller of the same portal.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Skopje-area buyers were covered in depth (Град Скопје, ЈП ВиК Скопје, ЈСП, БЕГ) plus the two national SOEs (ЕСМ, МЕПСО). The ~80 other municipalities and their ЈКП (Битола, Куманово, Тетово, Прилеп, Охрид water/heating/communal enterprises) were sampled only via one archive example.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the full buyer list from the ЗЕЛС municipality directory and the ЕСЈН InstitutionGridData institution register, then drive collection by authority ID rather than by per-site crawling.

coverage_gaps.description: Terminology for the specific demand of interest is not yet validated against real notice text: 'услуги на платен промет', 'банкарски услуги', 'ПОС терминали', 'картично плаќање', 'наплатни места', 'фискална апаратура', 'обезбедување и пренос на пари' — none was confirmed against an actual ЕСЈН notice in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a keyword-calibration pass directly inside ЕСЈН PublicAccess search plus CPV codes (66100000 banking, 30144200 ticket machines, 79710000 security services, 30142000 accounting machines) and record which terms actually retrieve hits.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language sources were not searched at all. A substantial share of MK municipalities (Tetovo, Gostivar, Struga, Chair, Saraj) publish locally in Albanian alongside Macedonian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian query set (prokurim publik, njoftim për kontratë, komuna, arkëtim faturash, terminale POS) as a distinct language lane.

coverage_gaps.description: Supplier-side visibility is missing: no register of the banks, security firms and integrators that actually win these municipal/utility payment contracts was located (e.g. Централен регистар company filings, bank corporate/acquiring pages, security-company associations).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a supplier-side lane — Централен регистар на РСМ, acquiring-bank corporate sites, and DKZJN appellant names — to reconstruct the competitive set from award notices.

coverage_gaps.description: No machine-readable interface (API, bulk export, RSS) was confirmed for ЕСЈН; the open-data page 403'd and the PublicAccess portal is ASP.NET WebForms.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate the XHR endpoints behind opendata-contracts.aspx and InstitutionGridData.aspx from a browser context, and check whether the Ministry of Finance publishes a documented API or bulk dataset before committing to a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: Retention limits of the ЕСЈН public front end are unknown; older award notices for this buyer group may only survive in third-party mirrors (Prizma/BIRN) or State Audit reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test how far back ЕСЈН notice search reaches for one known authority, and if shallow, treat the journalism mirrors and ДЗР reports as the historical layer.

brief: For state-owned enterprises and municipalities as buyers of collection, POS and cash services in North Macedonia, the landscape is strongly centralised: ЕСЈН (e-nabavki.gov.mk) is the statutory choke point through which essentially every notice and award from Град Скопје, the municipalities, ЈП Водовод и канализација, ЈСП, АД ЕСМ and АД МЕПСО must pass, with its open-data layer as the structured companion (currently 403-ing to plain fetches). Buyer-side sites (ЕСМ, МЕПСО, Град Скопје, ЈП ВиК) add annual procurement plans and supplier-revealing e-payment front ends that act as leading indicators, while donor-financed work for the same buyers bypasses ЕСЈН entirely and surfaces on EBRD's ECEPP and WBIF in English. Independent layers — Државен завод за ревизија, ДКЖЈН appeals, Центар за граѓански комуникации monitoring, and Prizma/BIRN document mirrors — supply the context, contested-tender detail and historical depth that raw notices lack. The main open risks are terminology calibration for payments-specific notices inside ЕСЈН, complete absence of Albanian-language coverage, and no confirmed machine-readable access path.
